title: Peru approves National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030 requiring public entities to align
date_note: Exitosa gives the day of publication in the official gazette El Peruano (24 Nov); the resolution itself was not read.
org: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros (PCM), Peru
summary: Exitosa reports that Peru's PCM approved the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030 by Resolución Ministerial 384-2026-PCM, published 24 November in El Peruano. Public entities must align objectives and actions with its priorities and appoint an Oficial de Seguridad y Confianza Digital. Exitosa says progress is monitored every six months and non-compliance carries administrative, civil and criminal liability.
plain: Peru's government approved a 2026-2030 cybersecurity strategy; public bodies must align with it and name a digital security officer, according to Exitosa.
exec: Exitosa reports Peruvian public entities, and entities under FONAFE, must follow the new strategy and appoint a digital security officer.
impact: Applies to public administration entities and public enterprises of regional and local governments, per Exitosa.

validation.note: Only Exitosa was read; El Peruano's resolution text was not found.

review.note: Compared resolution number, date, OSCD, six-month monitoring, liability against Exitosa
